clue.text: The rest of the wood comes on Saturday or Sunday

indicators.note: the wood piece follows on after the day's letter

parts.note: S abbreviates both days of the weekend
lumber is timber, sawn wood

explanation.surface: A carpenter's timber delivery is due at the weekend, the rest arriving on Saturday or Sunday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The rest' reads as 'the remainder' but means sleep. LUMBER is a word for timber (the US sense), and it follows S.
explanation.definitionFit: Slumber is sleep, and sleep is the rest a body takes.

clue.text: Broken forestay lost alternative security

indicators.note: the word forestay is broken up and its letters reassembled

parts.note: or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A snapped stay on a yacht means the crew lost a back-up form of security.
explanation.walkthrough: Take OR from FORESTAY ('lost' signals the removal) and rearrange FESTAY. A forestay is a rope bracing a ship's mast.
explanation.definitionFit: Safety is freedom from danger, which is what security gives.

clue.text: US writer rising to Holland's defence

parts.note: something rising is going up
the Dutch protect their land from the sea with dikes

explanation.surface: An American author stands up to defend the Netherlands.
explanation.definitionFit: John Updike was an American novelist, author of the Rabbit books.

clue.text: Fancy coping with bare adults dancing around?

indicators.note: letters dancing around are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Naked grown-ups dance round, coping with it fancifully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coping' looks like managing, but it is the capping course on top of a wall; a balustrade is an ornamental railing with posts.
explanation.definitionFit: A balustrade is an ornamental rail on balusters, a decorative top to a parapet or stair.

clue.text: Accountant taken in by traveller's summary

indicators.note: the accountant goes inside the traveller

parts.note: a rep, a commercial traveller or sales representative
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: A bookkeeper is fooled by a salesman's summary of accounts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in' suggests being fooled; here it means placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A recap, short for recapitulation, is a summary of what has gone before.

clue.text: Sort of iron only approximate in weight

indicators.note: the approximate word sits inside the weight abbreviation

parts.note: a rough figure is an approximate one

explanation.surface: A blacksmith admits the iron's weight is only an approximate figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrought iron is a kind of iron worked by hammering, as opposed to cast.

clue.text: Not a game for sea horses

definitions.text: Not a game for sea horses

parts.words: Not a game for sea horses
parts.note: a game played in water with horses would be polo; the tiny fish called sea horses are not the riders

explanation.surface: Sea horses are told this sport is not for them.
explanation.definitionFit: Water polo is a ball game played by swimmers in a pool, with no horses.

clue.text: Duck and swan up in the air

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nought, O
a pen is a female swan

explanation.surface: A duck and a swan fly up into the air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' looks like a reversal signal in a down clue but belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A question still open is undecided, which is what being up in the air means.

clue.text: Obtains help that was denied

parts.note: to obtain is to gain
aid is help

explanation.surface: Someone gets assistance that had been refused.
explanation.definitionFit: To gainsay is to contradict or deny, so gainsaid is denied.

clue.text: Taking steps to modify gradient

indicators.note: modifying the letters changes their order

explanation.surface: Measures are taken to alter the slope of a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Treading is walking, stepping along with one's feet.

clue.text: Castro on first name terms with field marshal

indicators.note: to marshal is to arrange or put in order, so the word field is rearranged

explanation.surface: The Cuban leader chats informally with a senior army officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'field marshal' looks like a military rank, but 'marshal' is a verb telling you to rearrange FIELD.
explanation.definitionFit: Fidel was the given name of Cuba's leader Castro, what friends would call him.

clue.text: Female teacher in form

indicators.note: the letters are put into a new form, reshaped

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman teacher is in good form at school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' does double duty in the surface only: the anagram fodder is TEACHER plus IN, with 'form' the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Catherine is a woman's given name, so it names a female.

clue.text: Acts as dismantler?

parts.note: one who acts in a play plays a role; a dismantler pulls things to pieces, and one phrase covers both

explanation.surface: Someone is described as behaving like a person who pulls things to pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismantle is to disassemble, and an actor plays a role, both covered by the same phrase.

clue.text: We object to journalist being employed

parts.note: the object form of the pronoun we is us
ED is short for editor, a crossword journalist

explanation.surface: We protest at a reporter being given the job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'object' looks like a verb of protest but is grammatical: the objective case of 'we'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something employed has been put to use, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Simple way in which the affluent live

definitions.meaning: the idiom for a life of comfort and wealth

explanation.definitionFit: Easy street is an idiom for prosperity, and literally an untroubled road.

clue.text: Type of comedy with important speech after interval

indicators.note: the speech follows the interval in the answer

parts.note: a rest is an interval or pause
an oration is a formal, weighty speech

explanation.surface: At the theatre, a comedy features a grand speech after the interval.
explanation.definitionFit: Restoration comedy is the bawdy English stage genre of the late seventeenth century.

clue.text: Not much reason for doubt

definitions.meaning: a ... can mean a trace or hint, as in a ... of garlic
a feeling that something is wrong

explanation.definitionFit: A suspicion is both a slight trace and a sense of mistrust.

clue.text: Cutters for the quarterdeck

definitions.meaning: hard enough to cut glass and other stones
one of four suits, a quarter of the deck of cards

explanation.surface: Ship's boats are kept on the officers' part of the deck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cutters' are small boats and the 'quarterdeck' is part of a ship, but both definitions are elsewhere: gem cutters and a card suit.
explanation.definitionFit: Diamonds cut glass and form one of the four card suits, a quarter of a pack.

clue.text: New crusades for old vehicles

indicators.note: a new version of the word gives a fresh arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: Fresh holy wars are fought on behalf of vintage cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Used cars are second-hand vehicles, already old to their buyers.

clue.text: The prisoner's tale?

parts.note: a prisoner is on the inside, so his account comes from within; the phrase also means a secret account of events

explanation.surface: A convict tells his story.
explanation.definitionFit: An insider's account of events, punningly told by someone locked within jail walls.

clue.text: Company to show displeasure with lame excuse

parts.note: to pout is to push out the lips in sulky displeasure

explanation.surface: A firm sulks at being offered a feeble excuse.
explanation.definitionFit: A cop-out is an evasion, a feeble way of dodging responsibility.

clue.text: Arouse revolutionary tribes

indicators.note: a revolutionary change turns the letters over into a new order

explanation.surface: Rebel tribespeople are stirred into action.
explanation.definitionFit: To bestir is to rouse oneself or someone else into activity.

clue.text: Cut grass, say, this way

indicators.note: signals that the word is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: if you cut grass you have mowed it

explanation.surface: Mowing the lawn is offered as the way to do things.
explanation.definitionFit: A mode is a manner or method, a way of doing something.

clue.text: Cook sent in more soup

indicators.note: to cook figures or ingredients is to mix them up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A chef is told to add more to the soup before it is served.
explanation.definitionFit: Minestrone is a thick Italian vegetable soup.

clue.text: Composer of regal variations

indicators.note: variations on a word rearrange its letters, punning on a musical form

explanation.surface: A composer writes stately variations fit for royalty.
explanation.walkthrough: Fitting, since Elgar wrote the Enigma Variations.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward Elgar was an English composer, known for the Enigma Variations.

clue.text: Raise the stake for mount hotly tipped when it runs

definitions.text: mount hotly tipped when it runs

indicators.note: in a down clue raising a word reads it from the bottom upwards

parts.note: the ante is the stake put up in poker

explanation.surface: A punter ups his bet on a horse heavily fancied in its race.
explanation.walkthrough: The racing surface misleads: the mount is a volcano, hot at its tip when lava runs.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is the Sicilian volcano whose summit is fiery when lava flows.

clue.text: Even the short-sighted could see it was dangerous

definitions.text: Even the short-sighted could see it was dangerous

parts.words: Even the short-sighted could see it was dangerous
parts.note: a short-sighted person sees only what is close; the phrase also means a narrow escape

explanation.surface: A danger was so obvious that anyone, however poor their eyesight, would notice it.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow escape is literally something close by, which myopic eyes can still make out.

clue.text: Designed to be a speedy vessel

indicators.note: something designed is laid out anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A boat is designed with speed in mind.
explanation.walkthrough: An E-boat was a fast German motor torpedo boat of the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: The E-boat was a fast wartime torpedo craft, a speedy vessel.

clue.text: Support us in shame

indicators.note: the pronoun sits inside the word for shame

parts.note: a stain is a mark of disgrace or shame

explanation.surface: A plea to stand by us in our disgrace.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain is to hold up or support, a direct synonym.

clue.text: A muscle unaffected by retraction

indicators.note: drawing the word back, reading it in reverse, leaves it unchanged

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A muscle is not harmed when pulled back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retraction' suggests a muscle contracting, but it signals the word reads the same backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotator is a muscle that turns a limb or body part about its axis.
